defs.def: work that is given by teachers for students to do at home （学生的）家庭作业

ex.s: I would feel completely at ease doing my homework in bed, with light music on.
ex.t: 我喜欢躺在床上做作业，放着轻音乐，感觉无比自在。

ex.s: Get up early to do my homework?
Unable to keep my eyes open, I decided I had no choice but to finish my homework the next morning.
ex.t: 眼睛都睁不开了，我决定别无选择，只能第二天早上再完成作业。

ex.s: It might be the time when you helped a friend with their homework, when you did the ironing without being asked, or when you baked cookies after the family had had a tiring day. ____18____
ex.t: 可能是你帮朋友做功课的时候，可能是你主动熨衣服的时候，也可能是你在家人疲惫一天后烤饼干的时候。____18____

ex.s: They are tired of doing their homework.
ex.t: 他们厌倦了做家庭作业。

ex.s: I had done myself homework but I was shy.
ex.t: 我完成了自己的作业但我很害羞。

ex.s: By the time I got home, I only had a few hours to do my homework, and I had to do it ___39____
ex.t: 等我到家时，我只有几个小时来做作业，而且我必须___39___完成它。

ex.s: “Even in families whose parents didn't have a college education... families are smaller, and the idea that children need to be carefully ___53___ has really sunk in.” The ___54___ of “adult activities” could not be attributed to more homework or extracurricular activities, the study said, noting that teens today spend fewer hours on homework and the same amount of time on extracurricular as they did in the 1990s ( with the exception of community service, which has risen slightly).
ex.t: “即使在父母没有上过大学的家庭里……家庭规模变小了，‘孩子需要被精心____53____’的观念已深入人心。”研究发现，“成人活动”的____54____并不能归因于更多的家庭作业或课外活动：如今的青少年做作业的时间比20世纪90年代更少，课外活动时间则与那时相同（社区服务除外，其时间略有增加）。

ex.s: And speaking of home, why aren't homework and housework the same thing?
ex.t: 说到家，为什么家庭作业和家务活不是同一回事？

ex.s: Next, write your homework in the new document.
ex.t: 接下来，在新文档中写你的作业。

ex.s: Three days ago, to complete her homework quickly, she copied part of the article without thinking.
ex.t: 三天前，为了快速完成作业，她想都没想就抄了文章的一部分。

ex.s: Her teacher was very satisfied with her homework.
ex.t: 她的老师对她的作业非常满意。

ex.s: Then, the teacher wanted to enter her homework into a writing competition.
ex.t: 然后，老师想让她把作业送去参加写作比赛。

ex.s: Daily Work/In-Class Writings and Tests/Group Work/Homework (10%)
ex.t: 日常作业/课堂写作和测试/小组作业/家庭作业（10%）

defs.def: work that sb does to prepare for sth 准备工作
